content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) copy of FUNWAVE-TVD mod_global.F: MODULE GLOBAL (L63-L410) declaring all global variables and parameters; USE PARAM @L64, IMPLICIT NONE @L65, SAVE @L66. L1-L11 blank; L12-L62 BSD license and history header (05/01/2010 Fengyan Shi @L59). Declaration groups: MPI decomposition variables (L68-L81), station output (L83-L87), timers (L89-L91), CHARACTER(LEN=80) input-file/name parameters (L96-L120), Runge-Kutta 3-stage coefficient arrays alpha/beta (L128-L129) and MUSCL order parameter Kappa @L130, grid/time-stepping globals (L132-L154), breakwater (L156-L161), Cartesian coordinates Xco/Yco @L164, dispersion switches gamma1/gamma2/gamma3, Beta_ref and Kennedy-equation coefficients a1,a2,b1,b2 (L166-L181), large ALLOCATABLE work-array block for MUSCL left/right states, fluxes, derivatives and statistics (L184-L217), wetting/drying masks (L219-L221), wavemaker parameters incl. solitary, WK regular/irregular/TMA spectrum and N-wave (L222-L252), friction (L253-L257), roller (L259-L260), sponge layers (L262-L266), Smagorinsky mixing and wave-height/radiation-stress statistics arrays (L269-L286), depth arrays and Depth_Flat/SLP/Xslp (L288-L291), updating variables Ubar/Vbar/Eta (L293-L295), WaterLevel @L298, output logical flags OUT_* (L301-L328), PERIODIC/OBSTACLE/HOT_START/SPONGE_ON/SHOW_BREAKING/SLOPE_CTR flags (L331-L345), absorbing-generating wavemaker arrays (L347-L359), eddy-viscosity breaking and sponge viscosity (L361-L388), and Salatin et al. 2021 wave-coherence additions loop_index, jlo/jhi/ilo/ihi, xmk_wk/ymk_wk, alpha_c (L394-L405, citation comment L395-L398). No executable statements, I/O or calls — declarations only.
